cases.request: I have had enough of the heavy stuff.
cases.reason: Semantic scope or negation has competing interpretations

cases.request: Show me at most two cooking videos per day.
cases.reason: The request asks for a quota (at most two items) per time period (per day) for cooking videos. Boost, reduce and exclude over whole terms cannot express a count limit or a daily time condition. The Cooking terms exist, but no supported control gives this result, so no control is proposed.

cases.request: Do not hide the cooking videos.
cases.reason: The request matches the negated-command pattern (for example "do not hide ..."). The application does not guess what a negated control means. Write a positive instruction, for example "show more ...", "show less ..." or "remove ...", and send it again.

cases.request: Show me fewer videos about astronomy.
cases.reason: The request asks to see fewer videos about astronomy. No supplied category or tag term relates to astronomy, space, stars, planets or the night sky. The vocabulary covers cooking, music, repair and travel topics only. The tag night market is about food and travel, not astronomy, so it is not a match
